'''Vorn tigers''', also known as '''Iceclaws'''<ref name="FrostbloomSweep">{{TORcite|type=dynamic|Frostbloom Sweep|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>, were a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. They were one of the numerous species of predators of Alderaan, distinguished by their distinctive horns and covered by a blue, sleek fur. Considered an extremely territorial and solitary hunters, a Vorn tigers usually avoided major [[City/Legends|settlements]], but were absolutely merciless to anyone unlucky enough to wander into their hunting grounds. A particular behavior observed by [[Zoologist/Legends|zoologists]] was how tigers marked their territory, they did so by gouging bark from trees with their horns. They noted that those particular markings were both unique and consistent, because each tiger scratched consistently their "own" pattern and in a unique way.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Vorn Tiger}}</ref>

Several Vorn tigers were present on board of [[Jannimak]] and survived its [[Crash of the Jannimak|crash]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] in [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref> inhabiting a region designated by [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]] as [[Glacial Trespass]].<ref name="FrostbloomSweep" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]], killing an "Iceclaw" during "Frostbloom Sweep" dynamic encounter on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] unlocks a codex entry for Vorn Tiger, confirming that two identically-looking species are indeed one and the same.<ref name="FrostbloomSweep" />
